craft_notes: FIRST-VERSE VOICE (verdict outstanding — same hand proposed for the whole song-set). Sthāyin: fierce seeking. Sanskrit first: sadyaḥ grounds (immediacy, recension-decided), vijñātamātreṇa drives. Rows: row 1 (evenness-last). Rupture: dash after itself. Close: end-weight on goal. Minimal pass: plain diction. Read aloud: what? how! evenness. Rejected: 'immediately' flat — 'at once' kept; 'sky-goer union' — killed: evenness kept.

lines: What is the Unsurpassable, Kaula-fruiting at once,
that by mere knowing brings Khecarī-evenness?
l4.sanskrit_cite: anuttaraṃ kathaṃ deva sadyaḥ kaulikasiddhidam | yena vijñātamātreṇa khecarīsamatāṃ brajet

reads_against.argmap: The question seeks the how of the unsurpassable granting Kaula fruit at once, known by mere touch.
c1_essence: Unsurpassable asked: Kaula fruit at once, mere knowing to Khecarī-evenness.
